properties.name: An open question its own promotion answered now gets asked about, and the instruction moved to the skill that runs at the moment of promotion
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
Two legs of the three-leg rule, in the order that matters.

(a) THE INSTRUCTION, MOVED TO WHERE IT RUNS. `capture-intent` step 1 now says: if the duplicate guard hands back the idea this came from, draw `EVOLVES_INTO` from the idea to what it became, with the reason in `evidence`, and direction is the claim. brainstorm step 5 already named the edge — and then handed straight over to capture-intent, which never mentioned it. The instruction lived in the skill you were leaving rather than the one you were entering, and that seam is exactly where 2 of the 7 fell through. All three skill trees (getting-started, .claude, .grok).

(b) THE DETECTOR. `decision_overtaken_by_promotion` in detect.rs: a live Decision at `proposed` with an outgoing EVOLVES_INTO to a node the design has already taken up. Same shape as `defect_overtaken_by_change`, one type over, and simpler — one edge and one status, no dates to order, no artifact walk. Severity 0.4, per decision, keyed on the decision AND what it became. Parked decisions skipped.

DELIBERATELY NOT DONE: `promoted_from` on add_requirement / add_capability. The typed-tool leg already exists — `review_relations` takes EVOLVES_INTO, and the duplicate guard exempts the promotion pair by name in capture.rs. A new parameter would have changed the tool schema, the toolsnap and nine tool descriptions to duplicate a door that already works.

THE DEFINITION WAS MEASURED BEFORE IT SHIPPED, and the measurement corrected the plan twice. The hand sweep of 2026-09-14 found 5 detectable instances; the shipped definition finds 11 of 277, because counting ChangeEvent and DesignRule targets — status-free, adopted by existing — reaches four the sweep could not see, three of them ideas that shipped inside one recorded change. TemporalFact was excluded on the same pass: a measurement about an idea is evidence toward an answer, not the answer, which is why the status-free rule is an enumeration rather than "anything with no status".

FALSIFIED BOTH WAYS rather than assumed: disabling the sweep call fails the 5 positive tests; widening the settled-status rule to accept anything fails all 3 exclusion tests. 10 tests, all told.

WHAT THIS STILL CANNOT SEE, stated in the detector's own evidence line rather than left for a reader to discover: only promotions that DREW the edge. An idea answered by work nobody linked back is unreachable by any query — 2 of the 7 on this design — and only the instruction reaches that half.
